title: Adaptive Online Learning with LSTM Networks for Energy Price Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2510.16898v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate prediction of electricity prices is crucial for stakeholders in the energy market, particularly for grid operators, energy producers, and consumers. This study focuses on developing a predictive model leveraging Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to forecast day-ahead electricity prices in the California energy market. The model incorporates a variety of features, including historical price data, weather conditions, and the energy generation mix. translated_title: 基于LSTM网络的自适应在线学习用于能源价格预测
translated_abstract: 摘要：准确预测电价对于能源市场中的利益相关者至关重要，尤其是对电网运营商、能源生产商和消费者而言。本研究专注于开发一种利用长短期记忆（LSTM）网络的预测模型，以预测加利福尼亚能源市场的日前电价。该模型整合了多种特征，包括历史价格数据、天气条件和能源发电结构。引入了一种新颖的自定义损失函数，该函数结合了平均绝对误差（MAE）、詹森-香农散度（JSD）和平滑惩罚项，以提高预测准确性和可解释性。此外，实现了一个自适应在线学习框架，使模型能够增量适应新数据，确保持续的相关性和准确性。结果表明，自定义损失函数可以提升模型性能，使预测更贴合实际。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合自定义损失函数（MAE、JSD和平滑惩罚）和自适应在线学习框架的LSTM模型，用于提高加利福尼亚能源市场日前电价的预测准确性和适应性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LSTM model integrating a custom loss function (MAE, JSD, and smoothness penalty) and an adaptive online learning framework to improve the accuracy and adaptability of day-ahead electricity price prediction in the California energy market.
